FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 198
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Allen Treadaway
Security
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 01/20/2026
House Bill 198 as introduced could increase the obligations of each sheriff, by an undetermined
amount to establish a training program for special reserve deputies executing writ of service
which could be offset, in whole or in part, by the training fee that the sheriff is authorized to
charge in accordance with the provisions of this bill.
This bill would also: 1) provide for sheriffs to establish a service fee of up to $250 to be retained
by the special revenue deputy serving the writ of seizure as provided by the bill; 2) prohibit such
special reserve deputy from the court for such service; 3) prohibit the sheriff from receiving this
fee.
